verdict.rationale: An operating system with documented developer APIs could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec or metadata, so this question applies to Windows. The evidence pack shows no such downloadable spec, and the OpenAPI probe found all candidate paths returning 404. Language and SDK mentions (C#, C++/WinRT, windows-rs, Windows App SDK) describe developer tooling, not a downloadable machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
